description:
The Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY) is a government initiative aimed at promoting employment generation in India. 

The scheme was launched to incentivize employers to create new jobs. 

It seeks to provide social security benefits to new employees. 

The primary objective is to encourage employers to hire more workers by subsidizing their contributions to the Employees' Provident Fund. 

Under this scheme the government pays the employer's contribution to the Employees' Provident Fund for new employees. 

The assistance is provided for a period of three years. 

Eligible beneficiaries include new employees who are registered under the Employees' Provident Fund Organization. 

Employers must have a valid registration with the Employees' Provident Fund Organization. 

The application process involves employers applying through the online portal of the Employees' Provident Fund Organization. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Labour and Employment. 

The timeline for processing applications may vary based on the volume of applications received. 

The scheme is aimed at improving job creation in the formal sector. 

It is part of the government's broader strategy to enhance employment opportunities in the country.
